title: Phase6B a P5_two_models_one_run
text:

  runs/models/mor_ic50 (label source chembl37_ic50_pX7_6, use the IC50-labelled rows).
They must not overwrite each other.

- split manifest: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprm1/ki/split_manifest.json
